publicationDecision.scopeLimit: All132 final-recovery calls measure a three-entrypoint candidate closure containing debt and slop, not the restored shipped closure. No additional132 run after these rejections; retained help measurements use exactly the shipped body within that rejected closure. No inferred full-suite result, causal attribution or future savings guarantee.

caveats: Known sums include only available numeric metrics; partial known sums are not full rows and missing values never become zero.
Full-row reductions describe all valid attempt usage; quality failures prevent efficiency qualification.
Changed-three versus unchanged-eight entrypoints are descriptive groups, not independent controls; shared skill closure/reference reads can affect every entrypoint.
The final arm failed before model turns with null usage; it is infrastructure evidence, not measured model quality.
Frozen measured closure is not automatically validated shipped source; rejection or later scope changes require an explicit final source decision.
